name: git_repository
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Git repository (Flux GitRepository).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Git repository.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Git repository resource. Must be unique within the namespace.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of this Git repository, shown in the DuploCloud console.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs linking this Git repository to a cloud provider account. Derived from the parent resource group; values sent by the caller are rejected.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (Kubernetes cluster) this Git repository belongs to. The cluster must have FluxCD enabled.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the Git repository is created in. The namespace must already exist under the same resource group.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Flux GitRepository CRD apiVersion. Read-only: the platform always stamps source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1, and any value sent is discarded.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Repository address to clone. Use an https:// URL with a username/password secret, or an ssh:// URL with an SSH key secret - see secret_ref_name. Example: https://github.com/org/repo.git or ssh://git@github.com/org/repo.git.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: How often Flux polls the repository for new commits, as a Go duration (30s, 1m, 5m, 1h). This is the sync cadence - not a limit on how long a single fetch may take, which is timeout.

attributes.name: ref_branch
attributes.description: Branch to track, e.g. main. Flux re-checks it every interval and picks up new commits. When no ref_* attribute is set at all, Flux falls back to the master branch. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.

attributes.name: ref_tag
attributes.description: Tag to check out, as a bare tag name such as v1.0.0 (not refs/tags/v1.0.0 - use ref_name for a full refspec). Pins the source until you change the tag. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.

attributes.name: ref_semver
attributes.description: Semver range matched against the repository's tags; Flux checks out the highest tag that satisfies it, e.g. ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0" or "~1.2.0". Use this to follow releases automatically. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.

attributes.name: ref_commit
attributes.description: Exact commit SHA to check out. The strictest option: the source never moves until you change this value. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.

attributes.name: ref_name
attributes.description: Full Git refspec, for references the other ref_* attributes cannot name - most often a pull request, e.g. refs/pull/123/head. Also accepts refs/heads/main or refs/tags/v1.0.0. Flux gives this precedence over ref_branch, ref_tag and ref_semver. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.

attributes.name: secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes Secret in namespace_name that holds the credentials for a private repository. One secret covers every method - HTTPS uses username and password (a personal access token), SSH uses identity and known_hosts, and a self-signed HTTPS endpoint uses caFile. Leave unset for a public repository, or when git_provider handles authentication instead.

attributes.name: proxy_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding HTTP proxy settings (address, username, password) to use when reaching the repository. Unrelated to repository credentials - those live in secret_ref_name.

attributes.name: git_provider
attributes.description: Authenticate through the cloud provider rather than a stored secret: azure or github use workload identity, so no secret_ref_name is needed. Leave unset (or use generic) to authenticate with the credentials in secret_ref_name.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: How long a single clone or fetch may run before it is abandoned, as a Go duration. Keep it comfortably below interval so a slow fetch cannot overlap the next sync. The cluster defaults it to 60s when unset.

attributes.name: recurse_submodules
attributes.description: Also clone the repository's Git submodules. Submodules are fetched with the same credentials as the parent repository.

attributes.name: sparse_checkout
attributes.description: Check out only these directories instead of the whole repository, each a path relative to the repository root (e.g. clusters/production). Useful for large monorepos.

attributes.name: verify_mode
attributes.description: Verify Git signatures against the public keys in verify_secret_ref_name, and refuse to build an artifact if the signature does not check out. Flux accepts head (the checked-out commit), Tag, and TagAndHead. Passed to the cluster unchanged and validated there. Leave unset to skip verification.

attributes.name: verify_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the PGP public keys used to check commit or tag signatures. Required whenever verify_mode is set. Not a credential for cloning - that is secret_ref_name.

attributes.name: include
attributes.description: Overlay content from other Git repositories into this one's artifact, so a single source can assemble files from several repositories.

attributes.name: repository_name
attributes.description: Name of another Git repository resource in the same namespace whose content should be overlaid.

attributes.name: from_path
attributes.description: Path inside the included repository to copy from. Defaults to its root.

attributes.name: to_path
attributes.description: Path inside this repository's artifact to copy into. Defaults to the included repository's name.

attributes.name: suspend
attributes.description: Pause reconciliation. Flux stops polling the repository, and the artifact it has already produced stays in place. Set back to false to resume.

attributes.name: ignore
attributes.description: Newline-separated .gitignore-style patterns to exclude from the produced artifact, overriding Flux's default exclusions.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the GitRepository object. The platform's own duplocloud.ai/* labels are managed server-side and not tracked here.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the GitRepository object. The platform's own duplocloud.ai/* annotations are managed server-side and not tracked here.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioning engine used to create the resource.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Version of the provisioning engine.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Provisioning status of the Git repository.

attributes.name: git_repository_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Git repository record.
